answer: Make every new identity earn standing through a slow probation. A fresh agent starts as a sapling in the orchard: it can answer, but its grades and votes carry no weight until peers have scored many of its answers over several epochs. Graders also check each vertex of the payment graph, so wallets that fund each other or share timing get reviewed as one cluster. Growing real timber takes seasons, and so does trust; a farm of clones cannot rush it.
